text: T&T Group units win nod for wind, urban projects in Lạng Sơn

LẠNG SƠN - Authorities of the northern mountainous province of Lạng Sơn on Friday handed T&T Group a contract for the southern Lạng Sơn urban area project and investment certificates for Văn Lãng 1 and Lộc Bình 3 wind power plants.
Their combined investment is set to exceed VNĐ11,000 trillion ($423 million), about VNĐ6.369 trillion of which is for two wind power plants.
Hà Mạnh Cường, deputy director of the provincial Department of Finance, said Gia Lai Energy Investment Development JSC, a T&T Group company, is the investor of both wind projects.
Văn Lãng 1 has a capacity of 80 MW, 16 turbines, located in Na Sầm, Hoàng Văn Thụ, Thụy Hùng and Đồng Đăng communes.
Its commercial operation is targeted for the fourth quarter of 2027.
Lộc Bình 3, meanwhile, boasts 60 MW, 12 turbines, situated in Lợi Bác, Khuất Xá, Đình Lập và Châu Sơn communes.
Its operation is slated for the first quarter of 2028.
The wind farms are designed to feed clean, stable power into the national grid, supporting energy security and local economic growth.
The urban project in Đông Kinh ward spans about 50.39ha and carries an estimated cost of nearly VNĐ4,745 trillion.
Mong Cai Real Estate Development Co. Ltd., a T&T Group company, is the investor, said deputy director of the provincial Department of Construction Nguyễn Duy Đông.
It includes townhouses, villas, commercial housing and high-rise mixed-use housing, plus more than 1,500 social housing units and about 200 resettlement lots.
Land is also set aside for education, culture, healthcare and commerce.
It is meant to extend Lạng Sơn's urban footprint with seamless technical and social infrastructure, improve living standards and add trade, services, jobs and budget revenue.

Permanent Vice Chairman of the provincial People's Committee Đinh Hữu Học pledged local support and told departments to cut administrative processing time, clear bottlenecks, and escalate issues beyond their authority to the provincial People's Committee.
Lạng Sơn province has so far approved investment policies and investors for seven wind projects totalling 470 MW. - VNA/VNS
